# osapi controller key

Read the key pair of the controller on this host.
`osapi dsl command get --name controller key` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | controller key                                   |
| Description | Read the key pair of the controller on this host |
